generation.scope: Every Klein window with three rank-one colors on each adjacent cut is classified for regularity, including all sparse supports: 39461472 candidates reduce to 52 sparse orbits and all are obstructed. The dense regular forms are a symmetric complete intersection and its nontrivial cocycle twist over the full punctured hyperplane sum(p)=1. Both have period one, their opposite ranks separate them, and the twisted rank drops from sixteen to fifteen on sum(1/p)=4 and to fourteen at exactly four points.
